definitions.title: Relative Rates of Growth and Big-O Notation
definitions.statement: Function g grows faster than f as x -> oo if f/g -> 0. Logarithms grow slower than polynomials, which grow slower than exponentials, which grow slower than factorials.
definitions.explanation: Quantifies algorithmic complexity and asymptotic dominance in mathematical analysis.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Growth hierarchy: (ln x)^a << x^b << e^(cx) << x! << x^x.
